corridor: Кокшетау-1 ↔ Астана Нурлы Жол через Астана-1
assumptions: Все вероятности, коэффициенты сопротивления, длительности, режимы блокировки и цены — учебные допущения; config.py источника не заполнен. Износ и аварийность КТЖ не измерены. Нулевые затраты на происшествия означают, что их денежный ущерб не оценён. Произвольная процентная экономия энергии и рекуперация отключены.

paired_model_cost_difference_kzt.interpretation: Illustrative period cost difference, not measured profit or annual ROI

limitations: Original railsim stations have unlimited capacity; CP-SAT replay still checks finite station tracks.
Original automatic blocking is a count of slots, not block-by-block train separation; default is semi_auto.
Source speed advisory smooths stops in accounting; it does not rebuild the executed trajectory.
Source traction estimate and physical CP-SAT profiles are separate models; their energy totals are not added.
Undetected hazards are simulated risks, not permission to issue a safe movement plan.
Core replay exports known closures and temporary speeds; source-only port/CIS modules are disabled here.
Annual economics from the source is not extrapolated from an illustrative short run.
